mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account(account_no, owner_name, member_id, brokerage_id, linked_at) VALUES(#{accountNo}, #{ownerName}, #{memberId}, #{brokerageId}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id, a.account_no, a.owner_name, a.member_id, a.brokerage_id, b.brokerage_name, a.balance, a.return_rate, a.profit_amount, a.holding_stock_quantity, a.create_at, a.linked_at FROM account a JOIN brokerage b ON a.brokerage_id = b.brokerage_id WHERE a.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY a.account_id

mapper.update: UPDATE account SET member_id = #{memberId}, linked_at = now() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND member_id IS NULL
